base_prompt: Write to a walking-group organizer suggesting a route with more benches. Frame the suggestion around making the outing comfortable for a wider range of participants. Use approximately 80 words for the response.
text: Hi, I’d like to suggest choosing a route with more benches for our next group walk. Having regular places to pause would make the outing more comfortable and welcoming for participants with different energy levels, mobility needs, or health considerations, while still allowing everyone to enjoy walking together. Perhaps we could use the riverside path or another route with frequent seating and accessible surfaces. A few planned rest stops could help more people join confidently and enjoy the social side of the outing.
